name: website-build
title: Website Build
description: The build scaffolding for a standard www site: a Feature per page type (Site-wide, Homepage, Content Page), each with Design / Front-end / Back-end / QA / QC tasks, plus a go-live release milestone. Apply alongside standard-delivery: matching Features merge and duplicate tasks are skipped. Extend with ecommerce-build for shop pages.

variables.name: domain_name
variables.description: The project's primary domain name, e.g. example.com

variables.name: foundation_list
variables.description: Task list (project phase) for discovery and foundation work

variables.name: build_list
variables.description: Task list (project phase) for the build

tasks.title: Infrastructure setup ({{domain_name}})
tasks.description: Environments, tooling and third-party accounts the build depends on.

subtasks.title: Install CMS
subtasks.description: Install and configure the project's CMS on the development/UAT environment. For Umbraco projects the umbraco-setup template covers this in more detail - skip this task if that template is applied.

tasks.title: Site-wide
tasks.description: Global design foundations and the site shell every page builds on.

subtasks.title: Design: Site-wide
subtasks.description: Global design foundations: grid, typography, colour palette, header/navigation, footer, buttons/forms and shared components, for desktop and mobile. Client sign-off before page builds start.

subtasks.title: Front-end / CMS: Site-wide
subtasks.description: Build the global shell: base layout, header/navigation, footer, shared components and styles, wired to CMS-managed content (navigation, footer links, global settings). Responsive across breakpoints.

tasks.title: Homepage
tasks.description: Homepage delivery, from design through to QC.

subtasks.title: Design: Homepage
subtasks.description: Homepage design for desktop and mobile, using the site-wide foundations. Client sign-off.

subtasks.title: Front-end / CMS: Homepage
subtasks.description: Build the homepage template and wire every section to CMS-editable content. Responsive across breakpoints.

subtasks.title: Back-end: Homepage
subtasks.description: Models, controllers and any data/integration work the homepage needs (e.g. featured content queries, caching).

subtasks.title: QA: Homepage
subtasks.description: Internal testing against the signed-off design and acceptance criteria: content editable as expected, responsive, cross-browser, no console errors.

subtasks.title: QC: Homepage
subtasks.description: Final quality control pass on UAT before client review: pixel check against design, real content in place, links and imagery correct.

tasks.title: Content Page (Generic Text, Privacy Policy, T&Cs, Cookie Policy)
tasks.description: Generic content page template, from design through to QC. One template serves the standard text pages.

subtasks.title: Design: Content Page
subtasks.description: Generic content page design for desktop and mobile - typography-led, covering headings, body copy, lists, quotes, tables, imagery and embeds. This template serves Privacy Policy, T&Cs, Cookie Policy and general text pages.

subtasks.title: Front-end / CMS: Content Page
subtasks.description: Build the content page template with a rich text/block editor experience covering every element in the design. Create the standard pages: Privacy Policy, T&Cs, Cookie Policy.

subtasks.title: Back-end: Content Page
subtasks.description: Document types/models and routing for generic content pages.

subtasks.title: QA: Content Page
subtasks.description: Internal testing: every RTE/block element renders per design, responsive, cross-browser, editors can manage pages without developer help.

subtasks.title: QC: Content Page
subtasks.description: Final quality control pass on UAT: standard pages (Privacy Policy, T&Cs, Cookie Policy) populated with real content and reviewed.

tasks.title: Go-live Launch
tasks.description: The must-pass launch checks. Every task here is verified on the live site before the project is signed off.

subtasks.title: Ensure canonical URL redirects are set up
subtasks.description: One URL per page: lowercase enforced, trailing slash policy applied consistently, and old/legacy URLs redirecting to their new equivalents. Spot-check with the network tab that a canonical URL loads with **no** redirect and a non-canonical variant reaches it in a **single** 301 hop.

tasks.title: Site go-live ({{domain_name}})
tasks.description: Release milestone: the site is live on {{domain_name}} with the Go-live Launch checks passed.
